```yaml
name: E2E Portal Tests with SOCKS5 UDP Support

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libclang-dev

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace --verbose

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: true

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: |
          pnpm add -g playwright
          npx playwright install-deps
          npx playwright install

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: |
          pnpm test:e2e

      - name: Run traffic verification script
        run: |
          cargo run --bin traffic-verifier

      - name: Run SOCKS5 UDP tests
        run: |
          cargo test --package imix_connect --features socks5_udp

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: Playwright Test Results
          path: playwright-report/**/*.xml
          reporter: jest-junit

      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./target/coverage/lcov.info
          fail-ci-if-error: false

      - name: Trigger downstream workflow
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        if: success() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        with:
          workflow: integration-test.yml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          inputs: '{"triggered_by": "e2e-portal-test"}'
```
